results.summary: Customer is locked out of their account because the password reset email is not being received after three attempts, and they need access to complete work due today.
Production dashboard has been returning 503 errors for several users since 9:05 AM, preventing the operations team from monitoring today's jobs.
Customer was charged twice for the same monthly subscription and is requesting a review and refund of the duplicate charge.
Customer requests a CSV export option for filtered results on the reports page, as their team currently copies data manually into a spreadsheet.
Since the latest update, the customer list page takes ~40 seconds to load (up from ~5 seconds), slowing down the team's daily work, though the application is still usable.
A new employee is unable to access the team workspace, receiving an "Access denied" error despite the invitation being sent to the correct email address.
Customer received a login alert from an unfamiliar country and wants support to check if any data was accessed or changed in their account.
Checkout is completely broken for all customers since 10:40 — the payment API returns HTTP 500 on every request, causing ongoing loss of sales.
Customer cancelled their subscription last week and is requesting a prorated refund for the unused days remaining in the current month.
The /sync API endpoint times out after 60+ seconds, causing nightly imports to fail for two consecutive nights, leaving the team starting each day with stale data and no workaround.
